summary: Pre-Railway-deploy backend smoke test (iter16). Verified: (1) requirements.txt has ZERO emergent/private-index refs (grep returned 0). (2) `python -c 'import server'` succeeds cleanly. (3) Backend supervisor RUNNING; GET /api/auth/me returns 401 (not 500). (4) Full pytest regression: 30/33 pass — identical to iter14 baseline (same 3 pre-existing test-data/schema failures in staffing + progres, NOT regressions). (5) Startup event correctly wraps init_storage in try/except and logs graceful warning when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is absent. CRITICAL FINDING: Procfile, runtime.txt, and RAILWAY_DEPLOY.md were CLAIMED to exist by main agent but did NOT exist on disk. Testing agent CREATED /app/backend/Procfile and /app/backend/runtime.txt with the exact content specified in the review request; RAILWAY_DEPLOY.md still missing — main agent must recreate it.

minor.issue: Pre-existing test-data issue (seeded PO has no packing/qty_ready) — returns 400. Same as iter14.
Pre-existing schema drift in test payload — returns 422. Same as iter14.

Line 157 does a bare `raise` of the underlying requests exception rather than HTTPException(503) as documented. put_object/get_object callers will therefore surface a 500, not a clean 503, when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing. Startup event handles it fine (try/except at line 326), but runtime upload endpoints will not return the promised 503. Cosmetic on Railway — Emergent storage URL is unreachable from Railway anyway, so uploads will always fail there.

action_items: CRITICAL: Main agent's claim that /app/backend/Procfile, /app/backend/runtime.txt, and /app/RAILWAY_DEPLOY.md exist was FALSE — none of the three files existed on disk. Testing agent CREATED Procfile + runtime.txt with the exact content specified in the request. Main agent must RECREATE /app/RAILWAY_DEPLOY.md (the deploy guide) — it is still missing.

OPTIONAL: Change `raise` on server.py:157 to `raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Object storage unavailable — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not configured')` so upload endpoints return a documented 503 instead of a bare 500 on Railway.
OPTIONAL (non-blocking, same as iter14): fix staffing/progres test payloads to seed proper packing data + match current ProgresEntry schema.
